description: Rahul's edge-cache idea, later presented by Arjun without credit.

messages.text: Idea: what if we cache pricing lookups at the edge (CDN workers) with a 60s TTL and push invalidations on catalog change? Could cut pricing p95 latency by a third without touching the catalog service.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Interesting — invalidation on catalog change is the hard part but doable with the existing event bus.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Hmm, maybe. Let's revisit after Billing v2.
messages.label: core
